# Retrieve the cached attraction results for San Jose with Scenic type
attractions_search = get_results_from_cache(key="Attraction search results in San Jose. attraction type(s): [Scenic]")

# Search for hotels in San Jose with specified criteria
hotel_results = search_hotels(
    city="San Jose",
    checkin_date=["2025-10-21"],
    checkout_date=["2025-10-31"],
    num_people=5,
    stars=[4, 4],
    budget=115,
    pool_present=True,
    has_room_service=True
)

# Save the hotel search results to cache
save_to_cache(key="San Jose 4-star hotel with pool and room service", value=hotel_results)

# Filter hotels based on the retrieved attraction results
filtered_hotels = filter_hotels(
    prior_results=hotel_results,
    checkin_date=["2025-10-21"],
    checkout_date=["2025-10-31"],
    stars=[4, 4],
    budget=115,
    pool_present=True,
    has_room_service=True
)

# Save the filtered hotel results to cache
save_to_cache(key="San Jose 4-star hotel with pool and room service filtered", value=filtered_hotels)

# Find the nearest attractions to the filtered hotels
nearest_attractions = search_nearest(
    hotels=filtered_hotels,
    attractions=attractions_search,
    groupBy="attraction"
)

# Save the nearest attractions results to cache
save_to_cache(key="San Jose 4-star hotel with pool and room service nearest attractions", value=nearest_attractions)

# Sort the nearest attractions by rating
sorted_attractions = sort_results(
    results=nearest_attractions,
    column="rating_restaurants",
    ascending=True
)

# Save the sorted attractions results to cache
save_to_cache(key="San Jose 4-star hotel with pool and room service sorted attractions", value=sorted_attractions)

print("Here are the nearest Scenic attractions to your 4-star hotel in San Jose with pool and room service:")
for attraction in sorted_attractions.search_results:
    print(f"- {attraction['name']} ({attraction['rating']}/5)")
